title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Accelerating the Construction of Smart Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Smart Courts

Fa Fa [2017] No. 12

In order to thoroughly implement the guiding principles of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the third, fourth, fifth, and sixth plenary sessions of the 18th Central Committee, and the resolutions of the Fifth Session of the 12th National People's Congress, and to fully implement the overall requirements for the construction of smart courts set forth in the Outline of the National Informatization Development Strategy and the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization, and to ensure the completion of the construction tasks set forth in the Five-Year Development Plan for Informatization Construction of People's Courts (2016–2020), which aims to basically complete the construction of Version 3.0 of the informatization of people's courts by 2017 and to further deepen and improve it by 2020, and to promote the modernization of the trial system and trial capacity through informatization, and to strive to enable the people to feel fairness and justice in every judicial case, these Opinions are formulated.

I. Fully Understand the Significance, Objectives, and Requirements of Accelerating the Construction of Smart Courts

(1) Deeply Understand the Great Significance of Building Smart Courts. A smart court is an organizational, construction, and operational form in which people's courts fully utilize advanced information systems to support online handling of all business, open disclosure of all procedures in accordance with the law, and comprehensive smart services, thereby achieving impartial justice and serving the people. Accelerating the construction of smart courts is an inevitable requirement for implementing the "Four Comprehensives" strategic layout and the five development concepts, an important component of the national informatization development strategy, and an important measure for people's courts to adapt to new trends in the information age and meet the new expectations of the people. People's courts at all levels must understand and promote the construction of smart courts from the perspective of advancing the rule of law in the country and promoting the modernization of the trial system and trial capacity, and effectively play the important role of advanced science and technology in serving the people, serving trials and enforcement, and serving judicial management.

(2) Correctly Understand the Work Objectives of Building Smart Courts. The goal of building smart courts is to establish a networked, transparent, and intelligent informatization system for people's courts that supports online handling of all business, open disclosure of all trial and enforcement procedures in accordance with the law, and provides comprehensive smart services to judges, litigation participants, the public, and government departments, so that informatization effectively serves trials and enforcement, makes justice more accessible to the people, and uses advanced information technology to continuously improve the scientific management level of people's courts at all levels.

(3) Accurately Grasp the Overall Requirements for Building Smart Courts. Adhere to unified planning and active promotion, guided by the five-year development plans for informatization construction of the Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts, in accordance with the standards of informatization of people's courts, and taking into account the actual development of informatization construction in various regions. People's courts at all levels shall take the initiative to advance the construction pragmatically and orderly; adhere to integration and sharing, efficiency and intelligence, fully expand the online service capabilities of various business applications, establish effective mechanisms for online and offline interaction, enhance the integration, interaction, and service efficiency among court business applications, between courts at different levels, and within and outside courts, and provide various smart service applications on demand; adhere to innovation-driven development and secure development, strengthen research on cutting-edge and key technologies, closely integrate the actual work of trials and enforcement, promote technology transfer and transformation and application, and at the same time, enhance information security risk awareness and protection levels in all aspects of planning, construction, management, and maintenance, ensuring information security while continuously developing and applying informatization.

II. Promote System Construction to Provide Strong Informatization Infrastructure Support

(4) Build a Full-Element, Intensive Information Network System. Based on court private networks, mobile private networks, external private networks, the Internet, and classified internal networks, build private clouds, open clouds, and classified clouds, improve the configuration level of various infrastructure, and achieve inter-network information sharing through secure isolation and exchange technologies. Use the Internet of Things technology to further enhance the informatization level of venues for handling cases and implementing the law, such as litigation service halls, enforcement command centers, digital courtrooms, remote interrogations, remote visits, digital judicial committees, digital meeting rooms, and information management centers.

(5) Build a Fully Integrated Application System for All Business and Full Procedures. Based on existing application systems, open data interfaces, integrate application interfaces, and expand and improve business functions to build an internal integration platform that integrates various application systems such as trials, enforcement, personnel, and judicial management, and an external service platform that integrates various application systems such as judicial openness, litigation services, communication and publicity, linking the internal integration platform and the external service platform to form a "one-stop" comprehensive service system, promoting platform resource integration, business collaboration, and multi-party utilization, and achieving seamless connection between online and offline business processing.

(6) Build a Comprehensive Information Resource and Service System. Improve the national judicial trial information resource database to achieve comprehensive coverage of trial enforcement, judicial personnel, judicial affairs, judicial research, informatization management, and required external data; establish a data centralized management and quality assurance mechanism, pay close attention to data sources, attach importance to data quality, and achieve fast aggregation, complete elements, and high quality; build a data sharing and exchange platform to achieve data sharing, exchange, and business collaboration among courts and between courts and external entities; establish a big data analysis system to develop smart services for judicial openness, litigation services, decision support, monitoring and early warning, judicial research, and work evaluation; explore the establishment of knowledge graphs for court business such as case filing, trial, judgment, and enforcement, and build an artificial intelligence perception interaction system for various users and a knowledge-centered artificial intelligence-assisted decision-making system.

III. Promote Business Applications to Significantly Improve the Quality and Efficiency of Trial Work

(7) Promote Process Reengineering to Facilitate Efficient and Orderly Operation of Trials. Based on the court private network extending to people's courts, comprehensively promote the synchronous generation and in-depth application of electronic case files along with case processing, build an online trial system covering the entire case handling process, fully support online case handling, achieve full traceability, dynamic supervision, and trial limit early warning, promote the organic unity of procedural justice and substantive justice, comprehensively improve trial quality and efficiency, and effectively standardize judicial conduct; promote mobile applications for circuit trials and enforcement, to bridge the "last mile" in serving the people; promote the construction and application of judicial assistance management platforms to provide judicial guarantees and convenience for major national economic strategies such as the "Belt and Road Initiative."

(8) Rely on Informatization to Solve Enforcement Difficulties. Build an enforcement command system covering people's courts at all levels, integrating case fund management, case closure management, enforcement consultation, enforcement delegation, public opinion supervision, performance assessment, and data analysis, to achieve real-time monitoring, top-down communication, remote dispatch, and rapid response, forming a unified and coordinated operating mechanism for courts nationwide; fully apply the people's court enforcement case process information management system to achieve unified management, multi-dimensional monitoring and error correction of enforcement case information at four levels of courts, strengthening business management and integrity risk prevention and control; further improve the network investigation and control system, comprehensively expand and enhance the scope and intensity of investigation and control, achieve business collaboration with investigation and control units, delve into the cyberspace, and analyze and mine clues to hidden property involved in the case; continue to strengthen the construction and application of the credit punishment system, achieve full linkage with the social credit system, conduct multi-dimensional correlation analysis of the credit data of persons subject to enforcement, expand the scope of credit punishment, and increase the intensity of credit punishment; vigorously promote the construction and application of the online auction system, support online judicial auctions of courts nationwide, and improve the efficiency of disposing of property of persons subject to enforcement.

(9) Promote the Up-and-Down and Internal-and-External Connectivity of Case Filing and Petition Work. Establish and improve an online case filing system, promote online cross-regional case filing, seamlessly connect with the judge work platform, and provide more convenient services to litigants; improve the informatization level of specialized litigation service equipment for information inquiry and output, petition reception and handling, and expedited case filing in litigation service centers, continuously enhancing the people's sense of gain; establish a timely information sharing and work linkage mechanism between higher and lower courts and between courts and other petition departments, explore the establishment of petition group profiling and petition resolution methods for cross-departmental stability control, and improve the ability to distinguish evidence and handle cases using multi-source petition data analysis.

(10) Use Modern Information Technology to Promote Judicial Reform. Establish and improve a traceability system for evidence presentation, cross-examination, and authentication, fully implement the principle of evidentiary adjudication; use information systems to support categorized management of judicial personnel, performance evaluation combining personnel and cases, and promote reform of the judicial responsibility system; establish and improve a system for categorizing, selecting, and evaluating people's assessors to support reform of the people's assessor system; establish a data analysis and evaluation system for judicial reform to improve the scientific nature and effectiveness of judicial reform plans.

IV. Promote "Internet + Transparent Justice" to Enhance Transparency and Convenience in Court Work

(11) Improve the Level of Judicial Openness. Fully utilize the Internet technology to improve the construction of the four major platforms for judicial openness, promote judicial openness work, and facilitate the disclosure of all elements of trial and enforcement in accordance with the law; promote the comprehensive aggregation, deep correlation, and convenient inquiry of judicial openness information, improving the level of judicial information openness and service capacity; continue to promote the open trial of court proceedings, publicize the trial process through multiple Internet channels, allowing more people in different locations to "enter" the courtroom and truly feel the continuous progress of transparent justice; further strengthen the construction and promotion and application of the Internet supervision and complaint platform, and strengthen the comprehensive supervision role of the public over all work of people's courts.

(12) Build an "Internet +" Litigation Service System. Provide more high-quality, efficient, and convenient litigation services, support the online handling of all litigation service businesses; integrate various litigation service channels such as litigation service halls, litigation service websites, the 12368 hotline, and mobile clients to build a three-dimensional litigation model that connects online and offline, and interacts between internal and external networks, providing integrated, comprehensive, and efficient litigation services to litigation participants; further expand online litigation services, popularize online mediation, online evidence exchange, online cross-examination, and online court hearings, build an Internet litigation platform supporting the entire business process; establish and improve an electronic service system, through information sharing with external entities, accurately locate litigation participants, and through information traceability and data tracking, grasp in real time the receipt status of the person being served, improve service efficiency, and solve the problem of service difficulty.

(13) Build a Multi-Channel Authoritative Information Release Platform. Use the Internet and mobile Internet application platforms to build multi-channel authoritative information release platforms such as websites, WeChat, Weibo, and APP clients, to promote the public's understanding, participation, and supervision of court work.

V. Use Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Technology to Provide Precise Smart Services on Demand

(14) Support Case Handling Personnel to Minimize Non-Trial Affairs. Fully utilize outsourcing service methods to establish an advanced technical guarantee and operation management mechanism for synchronous generation of electronic case files along with case processing, providing a necessary prerequisite for intelligent application of case information; continuously improve the ability to automatically generate legal documents, intelligently correct errors, and intelligently push legal language; the ability to synchronously transcribe court hearing speech, intelligently generate and push auxiliary information in real time; and the ability to recognize text, analyze semantics, and understand cases based on electronic case files, providing strong support for assisting judges in case handling and improving trial quality and efficiency; deeply explore the potential of legal knowledge resources, improve the deep learning ability to understand massive case facts, based on brain-like intelligent reasoning of case facts, dispute focuses, and legal application, to meet the precise needs of case handling personnel for laws, cases, and professional knowledge, and promote judges' consistent judgment in similar cases and standardization of sentencing.

(15) Provide More Intelligent Litigation and Legal Popularization Services to the People. Mine and utilize massive judicial case resources to provide services such as similar case push, litigation risk analysis, litigation outcome prediction, and pre-litigation mediation suggestions for various litigation needs, providing strong support for reducing unnecessary litigation and reducing the burden of litigation on parties; expand judicial service channels, explore intelligent legal popularization service equipment based on autonomous learning of legal knowledge and personalized interactive communication, to improve the quality and efficiency of litigation and legal popularization services; deeply analyze user litigation behavior, mine user personalized needs, precisely push judicial openness information, and enhance the sense of gain of the general public.

(16) Support Managers to Ensure the Proper and Orderly Exercise of Judicial Power. Promote and improve the automatic inspection system for court hearing procedures to ensure orderly, efficient, and standardized trial activities, and improve judicial credibility; improve the informatization level of trial management, personnel management, and administrative management, redesign trial management processes, promote the simultaneous operation of trial enforcement and trial management, and provide real-time intelligent early warning of deviations in the trial enforcement process, achieving refined management of trial work; explore the establishment of informatization supervision means that comprehensively cover the entire trial process, effectively supervise and restrict the exercise of judicial power; build an informatization evaluation system for judicial openness, serving the people, and judicial management, to ensure that justice is fair, clean, and efficient.

(17) Support Court Managers to Improve the Scientific Nature of Judicial Decisions. Use big data to serve judicial decisions, combined with trial dynamic analysis and intelligent judicial statistics, to scientifically analyze trial operation trends, scientifically allocate judicial resources, and improve the timeliness and pertinence of judicial decisions; use massive judicial case resources to explore judicial rules in new situations for criminal, civil, and administrative cases, and improve judicial prediction, prognosis, and emergency response capabilities; correlatively apply data resources such as cases and personnel, administration, finance, logistics, equipment, and informatization, establish an informatization-supported comprehensive management analysis, evaluation, and improvement system for people's courts, and support improving the scientific management level of people's courts at all levels.

(18) Support the Party and Government Departments to Promote the Modernization of the National Governance System and Governance Capacity. Deeply mine and analyze massive case information resources, monitor outstanding contradictions in social governance, predict the changing trends of economic and social development, and provide decision-making references for party committees and governments at all levels.

VI. Strengthen Work Guarantees to Promote Sustained and Healthy Development

(19) Establish a Regular Funding Guarantee Mechanism. Include the construction of smart courts in local economic development strategies, plans, and programs, actively strive for construction funds, and make overall arrangements in the budget for infrastructure construction, key project construction funds, and daily operation and maintenance service funds to ensure construction needs; make overall use of multiple funding channels such as the Tianping Project, special fiscal funds, and scientific research projects, establish a dynamic funding adjustment mechanism, and optimize fund allocation; explore the adoption of social capital cooperation models, innovate informatization investment and financing mechanisms, and actively guide social capital to invest in court informatization construction.

(20) Establish a Standardized Security Guarantee System. Vigorously promote the implementation of the Overall Construction Plan for Security Guarantee of People's Court Information Systems to ensure the synchronous development of informatization construction and information security systems; establish an annual information security inspection mechanism for courts nationwide, enhance security awareness, strengthen security management and protection, and ensure network security; establish a unified identity authentication system for court personnel nationwide, improve the personnel identity authentication and authorization management mechanism; improve the security guarantee mechanism for infrastructure, application systems, and data resources, and improve the ability to prevent, monitor, and respond to various emergencies on a daily basis.

(21) Establish a Quality-and-Efficiency-Oriented Operation and Maintenance Guarantee System. Build a normalized operation and maintenance guarantee system supported by infrastructure, application systems, data resources, and information security, and guaranteed by emergency response, to maximize the effectiveness of the application of informatization in people's courts; build and promote a visualized operation and maintenance platform to achieve visualized management of the quality and efficiency of informatization operation in courts at four levels and even in people's courts, providing strong support for improving operational effectiveness; establish an evaluation method for operation and maintenance guarantees of information systems from four aspects: operation and maintenance organization, operation and maintenance control, operation and maintenance process, and operation and maintenance resources, to promote the continuous improvement of the quality-and-efficiency-oriented operation and maintenance management system.

(22) Establish a Specialized Talent Guarantee System. Fully implement the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on the Construction of an Informatization Talent Team for People's Courts, formulate and improve detailed rules, and supervise their implementation, to provide a solid talent team guarantee for the construction of smart courts.

(23) Build an Application Effectiveness Evaluation and Improvement Mechanism. Carry out in-depth research, evaluation index design, index evaluation, problem analysis, and improvement of court informatization construction and application, to enhance the construction level and application effectiveness of court informatization; strengthen training on the application of trial enforcement business applications and judicial management applications, with emphasis on summarizing, exchanging, and training pilot demonstration projects; integrate multimedia publicity and promotion resources, and establish a multi-channel, comprehensive court informatization promotion and publicity system.

April 12, 2017
